name: adv-bench3_llama3
description: A dataset of adversarial prompts and model responses centered on Llama 3-related attacks. It measures how often adversarial inputs succeed in causing unsafe or undesired outputs from the target model, enabling evaluation of model robustness to prompt injection and adversarial evasion.
reputation: A niche Hugging Face adversarial-safety dataset used in model safety/robustness analyses; modest community visibility.
